utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Wednesday the eleventh. Can you all hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, got you. Sorry, traffic on the ring road was ridiculous. Three lanes of people staring at the same cone.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: You're better off there. The heating in the portakabin has two settings: Arctic and surface of the sun.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: You've still got your coat on, though.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That's his temperature control system. Very sophisticated.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes a facilities review. Anything already finished we can get out of the way?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, tested the boiler feed pump yesterday and it's all fine now. That's finished, not another one for today.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Good. Nice to hear something's behaving.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I already swapped the filter on the Palletiser yesterday. That's done as well.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, understood. Not carrying that one forward.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, onto what's actually needing agreement.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fiona, can you schedule downtime for the fire panel with production first thing tomorrow? Whenever you get a chance, rather than dropping everything now.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, so you're asking me to arrange the downtime with production, not saying the downtime itself has to happen first thing tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. The scheduling is first thing tomorrow. Whenever you get a chance in that bit of the morning; no need to jump on it now.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Fine, I'll schedule downtime for the fire panel with production first thing tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Separate to that, we need someone to do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the fire panel by Thursday. It's urgent. Scheduling the window doesn't cover that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Anyone able to take that sign-off?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Not me, sorry. I'm not available to take that one.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: No, I can't commit to it either.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And just so there's no crossed wires, I'm taking the scheduling, not that sign-off.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. The fire panel lock-out tag-out sign-off is still unowned, then. Urgent, by Thursday, but nobody's accepted it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Um, I'll inspect the Water Booster Pump for leaks tomorrow. That's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Leaks specifically, yeah? Not a general strip-down or anything?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, just inspect the Water Booster Pump for leaks. I'll do that tomorrow; fairly important, but that's the scope.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Okay, Sarah, clear enough.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie, can you sort the training records for the new starters on the 3rd, if you've got a spare minute?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: The new starters' records only, not the whole training folder?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Just the new starters, yeah. On the 3rd, if you've got a spare minute.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, I'll sort the training records for the new starters on the 3rd.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: The whole folder would need its own stand-up.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And probably its own chair. Not volunteering for that, before anyone says it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie, while you're there, can you do a site visit at Harbour Road Warehouse with the contractor next week? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Sorry, no, I can't take that. I can't get away from stores for the visit.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Fi, can I hand that to you instead? Do a site visit at Harbour Road Warehouse with the contractor next week.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, I can take that instead of Jamie. I'll do the site visit at Harbour Road Warehouse with the contractor next week.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks. Same priority: it matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Fine. We're leaving it as next week, not agreeing a particular day on this call?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's right, next week is what we're agreeing.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah so, mine: I'll write up the near miss at the PRV on the boiler on the 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: That's the write-up we're talking about, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, the write-up. I'll write up the near miss at the PRV on the boiler on the 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Marc. Got that.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And I'll take vibration readings on the turbine one this afternoon. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped out a bit there. Was that turbine one?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, turbine one. I'll take the vibration readings this afternoon. Not an urgent one, but it matters.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Marcus Hale on the readings, this afternoon. Full name because apparently we've got formal now.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Sounds like I'm in trouble when you say it like that.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Only if she uses the middle name as well.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: One still without a name: we need someone to do the pre-use checks on the FLTs next Tuesday. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anyone taking those checks?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Not me, sorry. Don't put my name against those.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I can't take them either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, nobody for the pre-use checks on the FLTs. Next Tuesday, it matters but it's not urgent. Leaving that explicitly unowned.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah. Me raising it isn't me accepting it, just to be clear.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: While we've got a gap, I heard a slight rattle from the AC1. Nothing to action yet, just an observation.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, an observation, not another job being handed round.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Same sort of thing: saw the pressure on the Compressed Air Dryer dip for a few minutes. It came back on its own. Nothing I'm asking anyone to do there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, both observations only.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And the Waste Heat Boiler is still blocked. Can't get to the Waste Heat Boiler until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. That's blocked, not work we're agreeing to do today.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Still waiting on parts for the HV board as well. Nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, that stays blocked. No point pretending it's ready.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, the two with no owner are the fire panel lock-out tag-out sign-off, urgent by Thursday, and the pre-use checks on the FLTs next Tuesday, which matter but aren't urgent. Neither has been picked up.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And mine are scheduling the fire panel downtime with production first thing tomorrow, and the Harbour Road Warehouse visit with the contractor next week. Yep, agreed.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I've got the new starters' training records on the 3rd. Not the visit.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Mine are the PRV on the boiler near-miss write-up on the 3rd, and turbine one vibration readings this afternoon. All good.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I'll inspect the Water Booster Pump for leaks tomorrow. That's us, then.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Lovely. Back to the tropical portakabin.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Enjoy your holiday. Cheers, everyone.
